ConnectionStrings._comment: DefaultConnection is intentionally empty here. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection' ...) or the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable in prod. See appsettings.example.json.

MlService._comment: AdminApiKey is intentionally empty here. It authenticates the Worker's POST /admin/ingest-news call to the ML service (X-API-Key header, security fix F-02) and must equal the ML service's ML_ADMIN_API_KEY env var. Supply it via .NET user-secrets for local dev (dotnet user-secrets set 'MlService:AdminApiKey' ...) or the MlService__AdminApiKey environment variable in prod.
